summaryTemplate: 10.5+ years in enterprise SaaS, building across React, TypeScript and Node.js. Currently leading an engineering team on a platform managing millions of customer endpoints, owning frontend architecture across a 12-package monorepo plus design systems, build and runtime performance, alongside AI-native engineering with LLM orchestration and MCP servers. {seeking}
snapshot: Lead a frontend team of 6 at SuperOps on a platform managing millions of endpoints, shipping weekly and owning hiring, performance reviews, architecture and roadmap prioritisation with product.
Enabled 50+ enterprise accounts at Freshworks, $100K to $1M ARR each, with custom Node.js middleware and microservices that met requirements the core product could not.

Delivered custom features and public apps across 4 Freshworks products to 10,000+ customers, built in React with Node.js services on AWS, secured with JWT and, for public apps, OAuth 2.0 where the third-party API supported it.
Architected an AI-driven end-to-end testing platform that cut full product regression from 6 hours of manual testing to a 40-minute automated run.
Built a Python MCP server exposing the codebase as a queryable graph, shipped as a Docker image on AWS EC2 behind token auth, now used by 3 engineering squads for their AI tooling.
Cut product initial load time by 70%, from 5 seconds to 1.5 seconds.
Hired 9 engineers and mentored 10+ across SuperOps and Freshworks, at 90% retention.

experience.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
bullets: Hands-on delivery of product features in React and TypeScript, including role-based access control (RBAC) and near-real-time operational dashboards tuned with custom cached Apollo GraphQL hooks to balance data freshness against network load, in partnership with product and UI/UX teams.
Manage the team's sprint planning, architecture reviews, interviews, mentoring and performance feedback, and roadmap prioritisation with product managers.

Reduced dev build time by 96%, from 2 minutes to 5 seconds, through a solo Webpack 5 to Rspack migration delivered in 3 weeks across 12 monorepo packages, reclaiming roughly 50 engineer-hours a month across a 15-engineer frontend org and accelerating time-to-market downstream.

Architected the AI-driven end-to-end testing platform in React and Node.js, where LLM agents generate, run and self-heal a 300+ test-case Playwright suite that now gates every release in Jenkins CI/CD.

Improved developer productivity by integrating custom Claude Code skills and MCP servers into the production development workflow, with multi-tier write-scope guardrails that let engineers run autonomous agents without exposing core platform interfaces to risk.

Built a Python MCP server exposing the frontend codebase as a queryable graph, packaged as a Docker image and hosted on AWS EC2 behind token-based authentication, now the shared context source for 3 engineering squads' AI tooling.

Built a headless Base UI design system of 30+ reusable components now used across 40+ pages and sections, with customised design tokens and a Claude Code skill that generates production components from a Figma node link via MCP, cutting page development time from 2 days, even with AI assistance, down to a few hours.

Cut the product's initial page load from 5 seconds to 1.5 seconds through route-level code splitting, React lazy loading and per-package bundle chunking, ending the slowness-related support tickets, and removed 30,000+ lines of dead code and unused dependencies.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer (Customer-Facing Engineering)
bullets: Technical point of contact for 100+ mid-market and enterprise accounts over four years, partnering with Support, Customer Success and Sales to turn account requirements into shipped solutions, recognised with the Customer Champion Award.

Built tier-1 SaaS integrations over REST API services, including the Jira integration adopted by 4,000+ Freshworks customers, alongside Salesforce, Zendesk and ServiceNow integrations for those accounts, expanding platform fit in enterprise deals.
Shipped custom features and public apps in React and Node.js across 4 Freshworks products to 10,000+ customers, with JWT for app authentication and OAuth 2.0 where the third-party API supported it.

Built the Node.js middleware and microservices behind 50+ enterprise accounts worth $100K to $1M ARR each, deployed on AWS EC2 with S3, DynamoDB and MySQL, delivering requirements the core product could not and keeping onboarding and renewals on track.
Mentored 7 junior and onboarding engineers on React, REST API development and UI architecture through structured code and design reviews.

experience.title: Software Developer (acquired by Freshworks)
experience.company: Niche Video Media / Infigenic — Chennai & Bengaluru, India
bullets: Built an admin dashboard that listed the features, bandwidth and storage limits behind each Stripe plan and let admins create custom plans on demand, increasing self-serve revenue.
Built video player customisation from scratch with configurable controls, annotations and call-to-action overlays, increasing viewer conversion.
Built responsive, high-converting company and product landing pages.
Integrated Freshservice with DocuSign over REST API services, unlocking a $500K ARR enterprise deal, and joined Freshworks with the team on acquisition.
